text:
sam: FYI rolled speculative-decode + shadow-prefix-cache to a 5% canary on prod at 11:04 UTC. Goal: reduce p50 for multi-turn short replies and cut token cost by avoiding full-model decode for predictable prefixes.
ida: quick explainer?
sam: two runtime pieces: (1) speculative decode runs a tiny 1B warm model to prefill first N tokens and the big model verifies/continues; (2) shadow-prefix-cache keeps recent verified prefixes in RAM for hot routes to skip re-verification when confidence is high. Both opt-in per-route.
trent: bench numbers?
sam: 40m live-replay + targeted multi-turn traces. For multi-turn short replies (<40 tokens): p50 12ms -> 5ms (~58% rel), p95 60ms -> 38ms (~37% rel), p99 260ms -> 210ms (~19% rel). Token cost per 1M tokens down ~17% (speculative decode saves full-model tokens).
ida: any correctness or hallucination problems from speculative step?
sam: automated checks show a 0.2pp change in strict-match on a tiny subset of reranking prompts where the small-model favored a different punctuation token; we gated speculative output with a verification step so user-facing diffs are rare. Flagged for QA.
trent: paste flags/config?
sam: pasted snippet: ```json
{"spec_decode": {"enabled": true, "prefill_tokens": 6, "spec_model": "tiny-spec-1b", "verify_threshold": 0.9}, "shadow_cache": {"enabled": true, "ttl_ms": 30000, "routes": ["/chat/short","/assistant/reply"]}}
```
ops-bot: perf-run id perf_2026_09_14_1104 - dashboard https://grafana.internal/r/redwood/canary/1897654321 - logs and traces attached.
ida: rollout plan?
sam: staged: 5% -> 25% (30m) -> 60% (1h) -> 100% with gates: user-visible strict-match drop <0.5pp, p99 long-seq unchanged, and no cache-thrashing errors. Rollback flags: disable spec_decode or reduce prefill_tokens to 3. Creating rollout ticket now.
trent: ops window 00:30 UTC ok? @ida
ida: ok.
sam: TL;DR: speculative decode + shadow-prefix-cache -> big p50 win for multi-turn short replies and ~17% token cost reduction; tiny strict-match delta under QA review; staged rollout tonight. Will post final perf artifacts after flip. :rocket:
